failures.rootCause: The recorded assertion appears tied to an older greeting format. The live page shows “Fresh start, Amber Demo,” which fulfills the objective but was not accepted by the check.
failures.suggestedFix: Update the assertion to accept or locate the greeting by the displayed user name, such as Amber Demo, rather than relying on a retired exact greeting phrase.
